# Apache Wicket

> Apache Wicket is an open source, component-oriented Java web framework of the Apache Software Foundation. Every component keeps its behaviour and state in Java and its markup in plain HTML; there is no JavaScript build chain. Maven coordinates: groupId `org.apache.wicket`, artifactId `wicket-core`.

Release lines in service:

- Wicket 10 (LTS): latest 10.11.0, Java 17+, Jakarta Servlet 5.0+. In service, supported until Jul 2027.
- Wicket 9: latest 9.24.0, Java 11+, Servlet 3.1+. Last release coming, supported until its final release.
- Wicket 8: latest 8.19.0, Java 8+, Servlet 3.1+. Last release coming, supported until its final release.

Wicket 10 and later use the `jakarta.*` namespace; Wicket 9 and earlier use `javax.*`.

## Documentation

Tutorials, how-to guides, reference and explanation for Wicket 10 and later, by topic.

- [Documentation](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/): the front page, with the five tutorial lessons
- [A–Z index](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/a-z.html): every Wicket class the documentation explains
- [Getting started](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/start.html): Create a project, configure the application and learn what Wicket is made of.
- [Components and markup](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/components.html): Pages, panels, borders and fragments, and how Java components meet their HTML.
- [Models](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/models.html): How components get and keep their data.
- [Forms](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/forms.html): Input fields, validation, conversion, uploads and submitting.
- [Lists and tables](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/repeaters.html): Repeat markup for each item in a list, page through data.
- [Ajax and JavaScript](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/ajax.html): Update parts of a page without reloading it, and work with JavaScript.
- [WebSockets](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/websockets.html): Push updates from the server to the browser.
- [Links and URLs](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/links.html): Link between pages, pass parameters and shape the URLs.
- [Resources](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/resources.html): Serve CSS, JavaScript, images and generated files.
- [Pages and state](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/state.html): Stateful and stateless pages, the page store and the session.
- [Requests and lifecycle](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/lifecycle.html): How a request is processed and what happens to a component along the way.
- [Localization](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/i18n.html): Translate texts, formats and choices.
- [Security](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/security.html): Log users in, restrict access and harden the application.
- [Testing](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/testing.html): Test pages, forms and markup without a browser.
- [Integration](https://wicket.apache.org/docs/topics/integration.html): Spring, CDI, EJB, OSGi and monitoring.
